id: title:arthurdedeus:rank account matches in command k results

review.posthog_relevance: Adds account identity and settlement checks to the CommandK ranked results, potentially improving account-related result accuracy and preventing display of unsettled accounts.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F6.H3 implements account query and account cache passing alongside results and persons, and checks account settlement. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement: CommandK now waits for account identity and account data before showing ranked results. This could improve account-related result accuracy and prevent display of unsettled accounts. No tier

observations.code_quote: - Accounts rank with the results when account search is enabled. The Accounts API matches the full search text, so an account can suppress the partial-match or spelling notice even when its display name does not contain the text. Distinct accounts with the same name stay separate. Accounts get no file-system **See all** filter.
